parameters.name: ApplicationId
parameters.description: The ID of the internal-facing application. Required.

parameters.name: DevTagMarkStatus
parameters.description:
The device tag mark switch. Required. Valid values:
- **Enabled**: Enabled.
- **Disabled**: Disabled.

parameters.name: DownloadAuditStatus
parameters.description:
The sensitive application download audit switch. Optional. Valid values:
- **Enabled**: Enabled.
- **Disabled**: Disabled.

parameters.name: PortRanges
parameters.description: The collection of port ranges for the internal-facing application. Multiple port ranges cannot be duplicated or overlap. You can specify up to 50 port ranges. This parameter takes effect and is validated only when Status is set to **Enabled**. If this parameter is not specified or an empty collection is passed in, the default ports 80, 443, 8080, and 465 are used. The effective ports are the intersection of the ports specified in this request and the port ranges already configured for the internal-facing application.

parameters.name: SrcIpMarkStatus
parameters.description:
The source IP mark switch. Required. Valid values:
- **Enabled**: Enabled.
- **Disabled**: Disabled.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The master switch for Layer 7 access of the internal-facing application. Required. Valid values:
- **Enabled**: Enabled.
- **Disabled**: Disabled.

When the value is **Disabled**, PortRanges is neither validated nor saved.

parameters.name: TimeoutSec
parameters.description: The request timeout period, in seconds. Valid values: 1 to 3600. Default value: 60. If this parameter is not specified or an invalid value is specified, the value 60 is used.

parameters.name: UserMarkStatus
parameters.description:
The user mark switch. Required. Valid values:
- **Enabled**: Enabled.
- **Disabled**: Disabled.

parameters.name: ZeroTrustStatus
parameters.description:
The host bypass prevention switch. Required. Valid values:
- **Enabled**: Enabled.
- **Disabled**: Disabled.
